backlog.title: MVP: Functional MCP Server
backlog.description: Deliver a fully functional MCP server that wraps mdsel CLI with exact two tools (mdsel.index and mdsel.select) and can be run via npx.

milestones.title: Project Scaffolding
milestones.description: Initialize Node.js project with TypeScript configuration and all required dependencies.

tasks.title: Initialize npm package
tasks.description: Create package.json with correct metadata, dependencies, and bin entry for npx execution.

subtasks.title: Create package.json with MCP dependencies
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/architecture/implementation_patterns.md for package.json structure.
2. INPUT: None (greenfield).
3. LOGIC: Create package.json with:
   - name: 'mdsel-mcp'
   - version: '1.0.0'
   - type: 'module' (ESM)
   - bin: { 'mdsel-mcp': './dist/index.js' }
   - dependencies: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.25.1, zod ^3.25.0
   - devDependencies: typescript ^5.0.0, @types/node ^22.0.0
   - scripts: build, start
4. OUTPUT: /package.json file ready for npm install.

subtasks.title: Create TypeScript configuration
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/architecture/implementation_patterns.md for tsconfig.json structure.
2. INPUT: package.json from P1.M1.T1.S1 confirms ESM module type.
3. LOGIC: Create tsconfig.json with:
   - target: ES2022
   - module: NodeNext
   - moduleResolution: NodeNext
   - strict: true
   - outDir: ./dist
   - rootDir: ./src
4. OUTPUT: /tsconfig.json file enabling TypeScript compilation.

subtasks.title: Install dependencies and verify setup
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Dependencies listed in plan/architecture/external_deps.md.
2. INPUT: package.json and tsconfig.json from prior subtasks.
3. LOGIC: Run npm install. Verify node_modules contains @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and zod. Create empty src/index.ts placeholder.
4. OUTPUT: node_modules/ populated, src/index.ts exists (empty), project compiles with tsc.

milestones.title: Core MCP Server Implementation
milestones.description: Implement the MCP server with stdio transport and CLI execution infrastructure.

tasks.title: MCP Server Bootstrap
tasks.description: Create the MCP server entry point with stdio transport. Research completed: See plan/P1M2T1/research/mcp_testing_research.md for testing best practices.

subtasks.title: Implement MCP server initialization
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/architecture/implementation_patterns.md for server bootstrap pattern.
2. INPUT: Empty src/index.ts from P1.M1.T1.S3.
3. LOGIC: Implement in src/index.ts:
   - Import Server from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js
   - Import StdioServerTransport from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js
   - Create server with name='mdsel-mcp', version='1.0.0'
   - Add main() function that creates StdioServerTransport and calls server.connect()
   - Add shebang #!/usr/bin/env node at top for bin execution
4. OUTPUT: src/index.ts with MCP server that starts on stdio. Compiles successfully. No tools defined yet.

tasks.title: CLI Execution Layer
tasks.description: Implement the mdsel CLI subprocess execution infrastructure.

subtasks.title: Implement mdsel CLI executor function
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/architecture/implementation_patterns.md for CLI execution pattern. mdsel outputs compact text by default.
2. INPUT: src/index.ts with server bootstrap from P1.M2.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: Add to src/index.ts (or separate file src/executor.ts):
   - Import spawn from 'child_process'
   - Create async function executeMdsel(args: string[]): Promise<string>
   - Spawn 'mdsel' with provided args array
   - Collect stdout into string buffer
   - On 'close', resolve with stdout (regardless of exit code, per PRD Section 6)
   - On 'error' (spawn failure), reject with Error
4. OUTPUT: executeMdsel() function that returns raw mdsel stdout.

subtasks.title: Define and implement mdsel.index tool
Define and implement mdsel.select tool
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: mdsel select CLI: 'mdsel select [--full] <selector> [files...]'. PRD Section 4.2 specifies tool behavior.
2. INPUT: executeMdsel() function from P1.M2.T2.S1.
3. LOGIC: In src/index.ts, use server.tool() to define:
   - Tool name: 'mdsel.select'
   - Parameters:
     * selector: z.string().describe('mdsel selector string')
     * files: z.array(z.string()).optional().describe('Markdown file paths to search')
     * full: z.boolean().optional().describe('Bypass truncation and return full content')
   - Handler: Build args array ['select']
     * If args.full is true, add '--full'
     * Add args.selector
     * If args.files provided, add ...args.files
   - Call executeMdsel(argsArray)
   - Return: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: result }] }
   - On spawn error: Return with isError: true
4. OUTPUT: mdsel.select tool callable via MCP. Returns mdsel text output unchanged.

milestones.title: Documentation
milestones.description: Create README per PRD Section 10.2 requirements.

tasks.title: README Documentation
tasks.description: Write README with required sections per PRD.

subtasks.title: Create README with all required sections
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: PRD Section 10.2 requires: Installation via npx, MCP server startup, Tool list and purpose, Example index call, Example select call, Selector grammar explanation. No philosophy, no marketing.
2. INPUT: Working MCP server from P1.M3.T1.S1. mdsel format --example output for selector grammar reference.
3. LOGIC: Create README.md with sections:
   - Installation: npx mdsel-mcp
   - MCP Configuration: Example claude_desktop_config.json or mcp.json
   - Tools: Table with mdsel.index and mdsel.select, parameters, descriptions
   - Example: mdsel.index call with sample input/output
   - Example: mdsel.select call with sample input/output
   - Selector Grammar: Brief mechanical explanation using shorthand notation (h2.0, code.1) with dot notation preferred over bracket notation
4. OUTPUT: README.md file meeting all PRD documentation requirements.

milestones.title: Integration Testing
milestones.description: Verify end-to-end functionality with actual mdsel CLI.

tasks.title: End-to-End Validation
tasks.description: Test MCP server with real mdsel invocations.

subtasks.title: Manual E2E test with MCP Inspector
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: MCP Inspector available via 'npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node dist/index.js'.
2. INPUT: Working dist/index.js from P1.M3.T1.S1. Test markdown file (PRD.md).
3. LOGIC:
   - Start MCP Inspector with mdsel-mcp server
   - Call mdsel.index with files: ['PRD.md']
   - Verify response matches 'mdsel index PRD.md' output
   - Call mdsel.select with selector: 'h1.0' (shorthand notation)
   - Verify response matches 'mdsel select h1.0 PRD.md' output
   - Test error case: invalid selector, verify error passes through
4. OUTPUT: Manual test log confirming output fidelity (PRD Section 7).

subtasks.title: Verify output byte-fidelity
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: PRD Section 7 requires byte-for-byte identical output to mdsel.
2. INPUT: Working MCP server, test results from P1.M5.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC:
   - Create test script that:
     * Runs mdsel index PRD.md > expected.txt
     * Invokes mdsel.index via MCP, saves response text to actual.txt
     * Compares: diff expected.txt actual.txt
   - Repeat for mdsel.select
   - Verify no wrapper fields or metadata added by MCP server
4. OUTPUT: Test confirmation that MCP responses are byte-identical to CLI output.
